name: Maian Crystal Pistol (test)
author: PD2
description: Test build of the Maian crystal pistol: a Tripo-generated, Blender-retopologised held model with a baked body texture and six crystals in sockets (five on the spine, one in the barrel). The crystals are the magazine: each shot fires one, it vanishes from its socket, and reload regrows them one at a time. Primary fire launches a crystal that sticks where it lands; three landed crystals near each other detonate. Secondary charges every loaded crystal and launches each from its own socket as a proximity mine.
